methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UNDP Human Development Reports site is a Drupal-based, server-rendered catalog of the flagship HDR series plus the Multidimensional Poverty Index and related reports. Listing cards, filter options and pagination are present in the HTML.

## Search
No dedicated full-text search endpoint was identified for this sub-site; discovery is via browsing and type/year facets. Accordingly, the search capability is not claimed.

## Filters
The listing exposes a type facet via URL parameters (field_type_target_id[..]) and pagination (?page=N). These are treated as opaque URL params; no formal filter schema is published.

## Download
Report cards link to content pages at /content/{report-slug} (e.g. /content/human-development-report-2025). Only cover image, short description and a Read-more link appear in the listing; the actual multi-language report PDFs live on the content/download pages. A two-step crawl is required to reach PDFs.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title, year and subtitle are in server-rendered HTML. No JSON/REST API, so enrichment is HTML-based.

## Limitations
Relatively small, curated catalog (flagship reports rather than a large document pool). No search endpoint. PDFs require resolving each content page. Behind a CDN; use a realistic User-Agent.
